title: Config Contract, Proven
prompt: Implement the `buildcfg` namespace so that every static_assert in the test file holds in this TU (no NDEBUG, no sanitizers, exceptions on). Same contract as the practice — this one must be exact.

tests.name: static_assert proof battery
tests.hint: Each answer: the preprocessor truth of THIS TU. __cpp_exceptions for exceptions, NDEBUG for asserts, __SANITIZE_ADDRESS__/__has_feature(address_sanitizer) for ASan, __cpp_lib_format guarded, CJ_LOG_LEVEL defaulting to 0.
